alignments.note: δέ → But.

Genitive absolute participle expanded into a finite clause; the supplied when and the auxiliary had are helpers on it (rules 7, 86). Discontinuous around the expressed subject Paul (rule 15). Head on gathered.
Παύλου → Paul.
Article before a name with no English determiner (rule 23).
Indefinite τι → a.
πλῆθος → bundle.
Genitive noun rendered of + noun; the case preposition stays with the noun, no article standing to anchor it (rules 17, 21).
καί → and.
The supplied object pronoun them is a rule 7 helper on the verb that requires it in English (rule 74's object contrast). Head on laid.
ἐπί → on.
Article → the.
πυράν → fire.
Anarthrous noun with supplied indefinite determiner; head on viper.

Compound ἐξέρχομαι: the particle out realizes the preverb and rides inside the verb's unit, headed on the verb word came (rule 106). The following preposition here is ἀπό, whose own English is written separately, so nothing competes for out.

ἀπό expanded into the complex frame by reason of. The carrier is a proper preposition, where rule 67 leaves the head open; I follow the corpus run that heads by reason of on by (rule 95's list of διά/ἐκ units). Heading on reason remains defensible.
Article → the (rule 19). Rule 95 notes that an article after such a frame is not owed an of the.
θέρμης → heat.
The supplied juncture and is a rule 88 helper on the finite verb it introduces. Head on fastened.
Genitive pronoun → the possessive his (rule 20).
The determiner slot is occupied by his, which belongs to αὐτοῦ, so the article realizes nothing (rule 20).

καθάπτω governs the genitive and the ASV writes a verb word of its own (fastened), so the English preposition on realizes the case government and rides with the governed word; no article stands with a determiner to anchor it (rules 21, 106). Discontinuous under rule 15.

review_notes: All three variant units are underdetermined on the base reading and the English realizes each projected token, so rule 97 does not arise.
The ASV's alternative-rendering note (Or, from the heat) does not change the token partition.
